in_marathi.name: Ekanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Unique, One of a kind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekanta means unique or one of a kind in Sanskrit. It is derived from the word 'eka' meaning one and 'anta' meaning end or limit. This name signifies the idea of being the only one, the unique individual in the universe.
